All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations (2, both redlined):**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical) — The cap structure is sound (mutual, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, full Excluded Claims set, payment obligations excluded), but the base is illusory: "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form. Redlined to the greater of all amounts paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.
- **LD** (high) — Section 7.7 imposes liquidated damages on us of 15% of annual Fees per week after a ten-day delay. Redlined to customary late interest on undisputed amounts.

**Compliant (16):** INDEMN, NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT, T4C (30 days + refund; no Vendor convenience right), RENEWAL, GOVLAW (NY law/NY County courts), ASSIGN, IP, LICENSE, AUDIT, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT, TRANSITION. Note that Section 12.3 affirmatively negates exclusivity, non-compete, MFN, minimum-volume and no-hire commitments by us, which disposes of the restrictive-covenant rules cleanly.
